name: WIN_Suspicious Remote Access Run Key Persistence
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: WIN_Suspicious Remote Access Run Key Persistence
// Vendor: Windows
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with WIN_Suspicious Remote Access Run Key Persistence.
// Severity: SEV_030_MEDIUM
// Category: EXECUTION
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0003 - Persistence
// Technique: T1547.001 - Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

config case_sensitive = false

| dataset = xdr_data

| filter agent_os_type = ENUM.AGENT_OS_WINDOWS
| filter event_type = ENUM.REGISTRY

| alter
    registry_key_lc = lowercase(action_registry_key_name),
    registry_value_name_lc = lowercase(action_registry_value_name),
    registry_data_lc = lowercase(action_registry_data),
    actor_process_name_lc = lowercase(actor_process_image_name)

// Standard user or machine Run / RunOnce persistence locations
| filter registry_key_lc ~= ".*\\\\software\\\\microsoft\\\\windows\\\\currentversion\\\\run(once)?$"

// Requested remote-access / masquerading references
| filter
    registry_value_name_lc in ("anydesk", "splashtop", "comms")
    or registry_value_name_lc contains "anydesk"
    or registry_value_name_lc contains "splashtop"
    or registry_data_lc contains "anydesk"
    or registry_data_lc contains "splashtop"
    or registry_data_lc contains "comms"

// Require additional risk context to reduce overlap with benign installs
| filter
    registry_data_lc ~= ".*(\\\\users\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\(downloads|desktop|appdata\\\\local\\\\temp)\\\\|\\\\windows\\\\temp\\\\|\\\\temp\\\\).*"
    or registry_data_lc ~= ".*(powershell|pwsh|cmd\\.exe|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32).*"
    or actor_process_name_lc in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "reg.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe")

| fields
    _time,
    agent_hostname,
    agent_id,
    agent_ip_addresses,
    actor_effective_username,
    actor_process_image_name,
    actor_process_image_path,
    actor_process_command_line,
    actor_process_image_sha256,
    action_registry_key_name,
    action_registry_value_name,
    action_registry_data,
    event_type,
    event_sub_type
description: Detecta valores Run ou RunOnce que fazem referência a AnyDesk, Splashtop ou Comms quando a execução aponta para diretório de risco, intérprete de comandos ou é gravada por processo comumente abusado. A regra evita alertar somente pelo nome da ferramenta.
alert_name: WIN_Suspicious Remote Access Run Key Persistence
alert_description: Foi identificada persistência suspeita na chave $action_registry_key_name , valor $action_registry_value_name , no endpoint $agent_hostname . O conteúdo configurado foi $action_registry_data e a alteração foi realizada por $actor_process_image_name sob o usuário $actor_effective_username .

TA0003 - Persistence: T1547.001 - Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
